MARTIN: 	David, does your phone have a light? 
DAVID: 	Oof, yes!  Of course. Good idea. Hold on.  	(Pause as he turns on the light)	Ok. Looking around.
[SFX: WE HEAR THE PHONE BEING PLAYED WITH A COUPLE OF BEEPS FROM BUTTONS PRESSED.]
[SFX:  WE DAVID MUTTERING TO HIMSELF ]
DAVID:	(sniffs air, absently and increasingly distracted) 	Fire is really. Have to find her…need to find…where is it…where is it…I need to be…	(we hear him shuffling around)	
MARTIN: 	David? 
NO RESPONSE.
MARTIN: 	David? 	(Under his breath) 	Godamnit.  	David, Helloooooo….?
[SFX: IDLE LOOP: OCCASIONAL FOOSTEPS AND OPENING FILING CABINET DRAWERS]
TRY A VERSION WHERE DAVID IS HOLDING PHONE IN MOUTH SO HE CAN USE HIS HANDS.
